name: Signed addition and subtraction

default.aim: Add and subtract positive integers, including crossing zero.

build.aim: Add and subtract negative integers; distinguish the operation from the signed number.

confidence.aim: Combine two signed additions or subtractions, keeping intermediate results.

add-positive.name: Add a positive number
add-positive.when: A positive amount is added, possibly crossing zero.
steps: Move towards larger numbers by the amount added.
Keep the sign of the resulting value.
add-positive.check: Undo the operations in reverse order to recover the starting number.

subtract-positive.name: Subtract a positive number
subtract-positive.when: A positive amount is subtracted, possibly crossing zero.
steps: Move towards smaller numbers by the amount subtracted.
Keep the sign of the resulting value.
subtract-positive.check: Undo the operations in reverse order to recover the starting number.

add-negative.name: Add a negative number
add-negative.when: The number being added is negative.
steps: Rewrite adding a negative as subtracting its positive size.
Calculate, including any crossing of zero.
add-negative.check: Undo the operations in reverse order to recover the starting number.

subtract-negative.name: Subtract a negative number
subtract-negative.when: The number being subtracted is negative.
steps: Rewrite subtraction as addition of the opposite.
Adding the positive opposite increases the value.
subtract-negative.check: Undo the operations in reverse order to recover the starting number.

linked-signs.name: Combine signed operations in order
linked-signs.when: Two additions or subtractions are linked.
steps: Rewrite each subtraction of a negative carefully.
Calculate from left to right, keeping the intermediate signed result.
linked-signs.check: Undo the operations in reverse order to recover the starting number.

start.name: Add a positive number across zero
start.question: maths:M13-WEB-DEMO-C1-Q1

start.name: Subtract a positive number across zero

confidence.name: Subtract a negative, then add a negative
